notes:
Summary: Mid-market product analytics SaaS focused on contextual help & in-app search. Evaluating Redwood Hosted first (fast time-to-value) then Dedicated if economics + SLOs match. Primary goal: replace ad-hoc ES + embedding service with single runtime that handles both online semantic search and nightly bulk embed jobs.

Key requirements / quotes:
- "Need reliable embeddings at scale — nightly pipeline ~200k docs, live ingestion spikes ~4-6k docs/hour." (Alex, PM)
- Latency target: 100-200ms end-to-end for search UX (top-N rerank + embed lookup), 50ms for vector similarity queries preferred.
- Throughput: baseline 200 QPS search traffic for product UI, occasional bursts to 500 QPS during marketing campaigns.
- Batch jobs: nightly embedding run ~200k docs, need low-cost bulk embedding (cheap per-token) + retryable/resumable jobs.
- Vector DB: currently PoC with Pinecone (dev cluster). Wants Redwood to integrate cleanly (native connector or low-latency routing to Vector DB). Concern: connector throughput and cold-start latencies.
- Fallbacks: want automated routing to smaller models during overloaded windows; also want prefix/KV cache to speed common queries.
- Security: SOC2 required, SSO for staff, KMS for keys, audit log retention 1 year, legal asking about EU data residency for EU customers.
- Pricing sensitivity: careful on per-embed cost for nightly jobs; open to Dedicated if committed ARR offsets unit price.

POC notes (technical):
- Ingest: 120k docs uploaded via S3 + ingestion lambda; pre-processing pipeline uses sentence-split + dedupe.
- Embedding run: completed first pass on hosted; avg embed generation time 25ms/doc using hosted profile (batch size optimized).
- Search: integrated Redwood embeddings into Pinecone index; baseline end-to-end median 180ms for 10 nearest, 95th at 350ms (needs improvement).
- Observability: Console logs show token breakdown and per-route latency; team liked token cost visibility.

Commercial / procurement:
- Interested in a 12-month Dedicated commit if Redwood can guarantee 99.9% latency SLO and provide an acceptable unit price for bulk embeddings.
- Legal will push for Data Processing Agreement (DPA) + clause for EU residency by contract addendum.
